evidence.decision: Selects semantic variant before rendering, independently matches weight/scale and distinguishes hierarchy from variable quantity and one-off versus ongoing effects.
evidence.artifact: Requires symbol names, available variants/modes, state mapping and fallbacks or a custom-symbol specification.
evidence.transformation: Fan control stops endless bouncing/whole-icon quantity tint and separates supported operation animation, speed value and stable readable housing.
evidence.verification: Checks deployment availability, erased layers and animation continuing after work; previews/localization and custom animation remain actual-runtime tasks.
evidence.applicability: Preserves licensing/trademark and restricted-product rules, adaptive colors and mode/weight/custom layer requirements.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Icons for metaphor, Motion for timing and Right to left for directional semantics.
evidence.distinctiveness: Symbol semantic layers, availability and meaning-matched effects drive a specific configuration artifact.
